integrity: The proof uses the published irredundant facet description, proves a strict analytic lower bound for every proper subset-facet distance, constructs the candidate ball, and obtains a matching global upper bound plus center uniqueness directly from the coordinate and total-sum facets. Finite verification is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the standard Euclidean coordinate realization and the redundant parameter regime m>=n+2. It does not determine circumradii, John ellipsoids, affine-invariant quantities, or analogous radii for arbitrary anti-blocking generalized permutohedra. A residual originality risk remains for a differently worded general Chebyshev-center theorem for symmetric polymatroid-type bodies.
title: The redundant-facet regime of partial permutohedra has a simplex-controlled inball
